brief: The 5-product skincare routine that replaced my 14-step regimen.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.subtitle: THE EDITED ROUTINE THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: EDIT YOUR SHELF
slots.body: I traded overwhelm for intention. These five essentials deliver everything my skin needs without redundancy or irritation. Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: GENTLE CLEANSE
slots.body: Start with a non-stripping balm or milk to dissolve SPF and impurities. One thorough cleanse preserves your barrier better than two harsh scrubs ever could.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: HYDRATING TONER
slots.body: A weightless essence preps skin to receive active ingredients. Think of it as the primer that makes every subsequent layer absorb beautifully and work harder.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: TARGETED SERUM
slots.body: This is where you treat. Choose one potent formula for brightening or barrier repair. Layering three serums creates conflict; one hero delivers clarity.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: BARRIER CREAM
slots.body: Lock in moisture with a ceramide-rich cream that mimics your natural lipid layer. It seals every step and shields against environmental stress all day.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.title: DAILY SHIELD
slots.body: No routine is complete without broad-spectrum SPF every single morning. It is the final and most important layer for preventing damage and premature aging.

slots.author: ELENA VOSS
slots.headline: START YOUR EDIT
slots.body: Discover the five-product routine tailored to your skin. Book a personalized consultation today.
